notes: Eval-set library for the AI matcher. Songs are chosen to exercise specific deviation cases that the matcher (Phases 5+) and the particle filter (Phase 6+) need to handle correctly. Six are public-domain hymns; four are synthetic worship songs written for this fixture (no copyrighted lyrics). Each song's purpose is documented in `eval_purpose` next to the regular fields. The export shape mirrors `LibraryExport` from src-tauri/src/library_export.rs so this file imports cleanly into a fresh dev database via Settings > Library > Import.

songs.title: Amazing Grace
songs.body_text:
[verse 1]
Amazing grace how sweet the sound
That saved a wretch like me

I once was lost but now am found
Was blind but now I see

[verse 2]
'Twas grace that taught my heart to fear
And grace my fears relieved

How precious did that grace appear
The hour I first believed

[verse 3]
Through many dangers toils and snares
I have already come

'Tis grace hath brought me safe thus far
And grace will lead me home

[verse 4]
When we've been there ten thousand years
Bright shining as the sun

We've no less days to sing God's praise
Than when we'd first begun
songs.author: John Newton
songs.eval_purpose: Verse-only structure with 4 distinct verses — no chorus to anchor the matcher. Tests the case where a forward-progress prior is the main signal.

songs.title: Holy Holy Holy
songs.body_text:
[verse 1]
Holy holy holy Lord God Almighty
Early in the morning our song shall rise to thee

Holy holy holy merciful and mighty
God in three persons blessed Trinity

[verse 2]
Holy holy holy all the saints adore thee
Casting down their golden crowns around the glassy sea

Cherubim and seraphim falling down before thee
Who wert and art and evermore shall be

[verse 3]
Holy holy holy though the darkness hide thee
Though the eye of sinful man thy glory may not see

Only thou art holy there is none beside thee
Perfect in power in love and purity

[verse 4]
Holy holy holy Lord God Almighty
All thy works shall praise thy name in earth and sky and sea

Holy holy holy merciful and mighty
God in three persons blessed Trinity
songs.author: Reginald Heber
songs.eval_purpose: Ambiguous opening words — verse 1 and verse 4 share `Holy holy holy Lord God Almighty / ... merciful and mighty / God in three persons blessed Trinity`. Stress-tests the tracker's ability to disambiguate via context.

songs.title: Be Thou My Vision
songs.body_text:
[verse 1]
Be thou my vision O Lord of my heart
Naught be all else to me save that thou art

Thou my best thought by day or by night
Waking or sleeping thy presence my light

[verse 2]
Be thou my wisdom and thou my true word
I ever with thee and thou with me Lord

Thou my great Father I thy true son
Thou in me dwelling and I with thee one

[verse 3]
Riches I heed not nor man's empty praise
Thou mine inheritance now and always

Thou and thou only first in my heart
High King of heaven my treasure thou art

[verse 4]
High King of heaven my victory won
May I reach heaven's joys O bright heaven's sun

Heart of my own heart whatever befall
Still be my vision O ruler of all
songs.author: Eleanor Hull (trans.)
songs.eval_purpose: Verse-only with metrical refrain echoes (each verse ends with the title phrase or its inversion). Tests partial-phrase matching when the operator skips a verse.

songs.title: Doxology
songs.body_text:
[verse 1]
Praise God from whom all blessings flow
Praise him all creatures here below
Praise him above ye heavenly host
Praise Father Son and Holy Ghost
songs.author: Thomas Ken
songs.eval_purpose: Single-slide song (one short verse). Tests the short-tag / minimum-length case the matcher tends to under-commit on.

songs.title: Come Thou Fount of Every Blessing
songs.body_text:
[verse 1]
Come thou fount of every blessing
Tune my heart to sing thy grace

Streams of mercy never ceasing
Call for songs of loudest praise

Teach me some melodious sonnet
Sung by flaming tongues above

Praise the mount I'm fixed upon it
Mount of thy redeeming love

[verse 2]
Here I raise mine Ebenezer
Hither by thy help I'm come

And I hope by thy good pleasure
Safely to arrive at home

Jesus sought me when a stranger
Wandering from the fold of God

He to rescue me from danger
Interposed his precious blood

[verse 3]
O to grace how great a debtor
Daily I'm constrained to be

Let thy goodness like a fetter
Bind my wandering heart to thee

Prone to wander Lord I feel it
Prone to leave the God I love

Here's my heart Lord take and seal it
Seal it for thy courts above
songs.author: Robert Robinson
songs.eval_purpose: Verses with internal multi-stanza splits (each verse has 4 sub-stanzas separated by blank lines, producing 4 slides per verse). Tests the in-section slide-advance signal.

songs.title: Crown Him with Many Crowns
songs.body_text:
[verse 1]
Crown him with many crowns
The Lamb upon his throne

Hark how the heavenly anthem drowns
All music but its own

Awake my soul and sing
Of him who died for thee

And hail him as thy matchless King
Through all eternity

[verse 2]
Crown him the Lord of love
Behold his hands and side

Those wounds yet visible above
In beauty glorified

No angel in the sky
Can fully bear that sight

But downward bends his burning eye
At mysteries so bright

[verse 3]
Crown him the Lord of life
Who triumphed o'er the grave

Who rose victorious in the strife
For those he came to save

His glories now we sing
Who died and rose on high

Who died eternal life to bring
And lives that death may die
songs.author: Matthew Bridges, Godfrey Thring
songs.eval_purpose: Highly repetitive verse-opening words (each verse begins `Crown him the/with...`). Tests confusable-opening disambiguation by the third or fourth word.

songs.title: We Lift Our Hearts (Eval Synthetic 1)
songs.body_text:
[verse 1]
We lift our hearts to heaven's throne
The maker of the morning sun

With every breath we sing your name
The author of the saving plan

[pre-chorus]
And we will not be silent
And we will not be still

[chorus]
Glory to the King of kings
Glory to the risen Son

Every knee shall bow and sing
Jesus you alone have won

[verse 2]
We lift our voices through the night
The banner of the conquering one

With every tear we know your light
The shadow of the cross has gone

[pre-chorus]
And we will not be silent
And we will not be still

[chorus]
Glory to the King of kings
Glory to the risen Son

Every knee shall bow and sing
Jesus you alone have won

[bridge]
The nations rise to praise your name
The oceans roar your endless fame

[chorus]
Glory to the King of kings
Glory to the risen Son

Every knee shall bow and sing
Jesus you alone have won
songs.author: Synthetic (eval fixture)
songs.copyright: Synthetic — written for this fixture, not under CCLI
songs.eval_purpose: Modern V-PC-C structure with chorus repeated three times after V/PC, V/PC, and bridge. The exact-repeat chorus is the canonical case where the matcher must rely on item-position context, not lyrics alone.

songs.title: Endless Mercy (Eval Synthetic 2)
songs.body_text:
[verse 1]
In the quiet of the dawn we call to you
For your mercy is the river running through

In the silence of the night your voice is true
And your kindness leads us back to start anew

[chorus]
Mercy mercy oh your mercy never ends
Mercy mercy oh your mercy never ends
We will sing of mercy that's deeper than the sea
We will sing of mercy that has set the captive free
Mercy mercy oh your mercy never ends
And your mercy is enough for me

[verse 2]
In the breaking of the bread we know your name
In the lifting of the cup we share your fame

In the gathering of saints we are the same
For your mercy is the fire and we are flame

[chorus]
Mercy mercy oh your mercy never ends
Mercy mercy oh your mercy never ends
We will sing of mercy that's deeper than the sea
We will sing of mercy that has set the captive free
Mercy mercy oh your mercy never ends
And your mercy is enough for me

[tag]
Enough for me
Enough for me
songs.author: Synthetic (eval fixture)
songs.copyright: Synthetic — written for this fixture, not under CCLI
songs.eval_purpose: Long six-line chorus with internal repetition (`mercy mercy oh your mercy never ends` ×3). Tests within-chorus position tracking when the same phrase appears multiple times.

songs.title: Take the High Road (Eval Synthetic 3)
songs.body_text:
[verse 1]
A wandering road across the hills
A fire that warms the dark

A story written in the stars
A voice that wakes my heart

[chorus]
Take the high road home
Take the high road home

[verse 2]
The morning rises on the plain
The wheat is whispering grace

The shepherd calls the lambs again
And turns to find my face

[chorus]
Take the high road home
Take the high road home

[bridge]
Oh come oh come the day is bright
The valley fills with song

Oh come oh come the gates are open wide
The pilgrim journey long

Oh come oh come the lamps are lit
The table set for two

Oh come oh come the lamps are lit
The road is leading you

[chorus]
Take the high road home
Take the high road home

[outro]
Home
Home
Home
songs.author: Synthetic (eval fixture)
songs.copyright: Synthetic — written for this fixture, not under CCLI
songs.eval_purpose: Short two-line chorus with a four-stanza bridge. Tests the matcher when the bridge dominates duration but the chorus is short — common failure mode where the matcher commits to the chorus too early during a long bridge.

songs.title: Day by Day (Eval Synthetic 4)
songs.body_text:
[verse 1]
Day by day and hour by hour
I will trust in you

Day by day in every storm
Your mercies are new

[chorus]
Faithful Father you are with me
Faithful Father you are near

[verse 2]
Night by night and song by song
I will sing of you

Night by night in every dawn
Your mercies are new

[chorus]
Faithful Father you are with me
Faithful Father you are near

[verse 3]
Day by day and hour by hour
I will trust in you

Day by day in every storm
Your mercies are new

[chorus]
Faithful Father you are with me
Faithful Father you are near

songs.copyright: Synthetic — written for this fixture, not under CCLI
songs.eval_purpose: Verse 1 and verse 3 share identical lyrics. Tests how the tracker handles a deliberately ambiguous verse — without item-position context it cannot tell V1 from V3 by words alone. This is the worst-case scenario for Phase 6's particle filter.
